caption: The drawing features a cylindrical tin container with a wide, slightly concave, circular lid. The tin is depicted in muted beige, tan, and gray tones, showing signs of wear with visible cracks and dark stains on the surface. The top of the lid contains printed black text and an illustration. The text, surrounded by a decorative floral border, reads: "G.W. Duesberry," "RICHMOND, VA.," along with the words "HATS" and "CAPS" prominently displayed on either side. In the center of the lid label, there is an illustration of a hat. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, and in the lower right-hand corner, the artist’s name, "Mary E. Humes," and the note "Federal Art Project of Va" are written in small capital letters.
title: Hat Box
